items.label: Vintage Side Table
items.value: This side table features a sleek, unique design with delicate spindle legs, adding a touch of retro charm to your home while blending seamlessly with modern minimalist decor, complementing any furniture style. Perfect for any space whether in living room, bedroom, or office

items.label: 3-Tier Storage
items.value: This end table features a versatile 3-tier design, offering ample storage: the top tier holds drinks or snacks, the middle shelf displays books or decor, and the bottom level stores bins to keep your space tidy and organized

items.label: Compact Size
items.value: With dimensions of 11.8"D x 13.4"W x 22.6"H, this small table fits perfectly in tight spaces like gaps between sofas and walls, small corners, or as a stylish bedside table, maximizing utility without clutter

items.label: Sturdy & Safe Construction
items.value: This nightstand is crafted from high-quality MDF wood and sturdy solid wood legs for exceptional stability and reliable support. Its smooth and water-resistant surface ensures easy cleaning, while the rounded edges enhance safety by preventing accidental bumps and injuries

items.label: Easy to Assemble
items.value: This bedside table includes all necessary hardware and clear, step-by-step instructions. You can assemble it in just minutes without any tools required. If you have any questions, please feel free to reach out to us – we're here to assist you throughout the entire process
